run_ade20k_instance_json_prep: run the script to convert ADE20K instance segmentation annotations into COCO-format JSON
build_ade20k_coco_annotations: build COCO-format instance annotation JSON files from ADE20K training and validation data
convert_ade20k_instance_masks: convert ADE20K instance PNG masks into RLE-encoded segmentation annotations with bounding boxes
map_ade20k_category_ids: map ADE20K instance category IDs to shared semantic IDs using the catid mapping file
extract_ade20k_bbox_and_area: extract bounding boxes and compute mask areas for each instance in ADE20K segmentation masks
